title: 负面宣传砸6.12亿：竟是正面宣传三倍，选民到底在反对什么？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's send these lunatics back in and govern our country for the future.
segments.zh: 让我们把这些疯子送回去，为未来治理我们的国家。

segments.en: Candidates across the country are framing midterm contests around what voters opposed rather than what they support.
segments.zh: 全国各地的候选人将中期选举的竞争围绕选民反对什么而非支持什么来展开。

segments.en: Because for the past eight months, all they've done is made things worse for Ohioans.
segments.zh: 因为过去八个月，他们所做的一切只是让俄亥俄州人的处境更糟。

segments.en: John Houston will get Washington out of the way.
segments.zh: 约翰·休斯顿将让华盛顿不再碍事。

segments.en: Political scientists like Stephen Webster from Indiana University say that has amplified the sense of dissatisfaction among the electorate.
segments.zh: 印第安纳大学的政治学家斯蒂芬·韦伯斯特等人表示，这放大了选民的不满情绪。

segments.en: One thing we know about American politics is that increasingly it's driven by who we dislike rather than who we like.
segments.zh: 我们对美国政治的了解之一是，它越来越由我们不喜欢谁而非喜欢谁来驱动。

segments.en: And a lot of money is going toward fueling those feelings.
segments.zh: 大量资金正用于助长这些情绪。

segments.en: An analysis of FEC filings by Bloomberg shows spending by outside groups like Superpacks on negative opposition ads, direct mail, door hangers, and other messaging totaled $612 million
segments.zh: 彭博社对联邦选举委员会文件的分析显示，9月份，超级政治行动委员会等外部团体在负面反对广告、直邮、门挂宣传和其他信息传递上的支出总计6.12亿美元。

segments.en: in September. That's more than triple the amount spent on positive messages.
segments.zh: 这一数字是正面信息支出金额的三倍多。

segments.en: As we wait to see the results of that spending, we do know that this is an electorate with remarkably low trust in the institution behind me, which is at the center of the midterm elections.
segments.zh: 在我们等待这些支出的结果时，我们确实知道，这个选民群体对我身后的机构信任度极低，而该机构正是中期选举的核心。

segments.en: A Pew Research Center survey from this summer found just 25% of Americans held a favorable view of Congress.
segments.zh: 皮尤研究中心今年夏天的一项调查发现，只有25%的美国人对国会持正面看法。

segments.en: That's down 9% points in the last year.
segments.zh: 这比去年下降了9个百分点。
不满情绪跨越了党派界限。
